title: December, 2018
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Does Chloe come home. Not this year. A text. The strip draws a phone for the first time and does not enjoy it.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD's flip phone — still a flip phone — open on the drafting table. A text. BARNABY II.

image.prompt: an old flip phone open on a drafting table showing a text message, a man looking at it, a three-legged dog, razor-sharp ink

panels.composition: The screen, tiny: 'seattle. not this yr. sorry. — c'

image.prompt: close-up of a small flip-phone screen with a short lowercase text message
image.notes: Letter after: seattle. not this yr. sorry. — c

balloons.text: Twelve words. She used to need a lamp.

image.prompt: a man holding a flip phone and speaking to a three-legged dog with a rueful expression

panels.composition: The phone closed. On the corkboard, no room left; Wood pins nothing. The first December with nothing pinned.

image.prompt: a man closing a flip phone at a drafting table below a corkboard so crowded nothing more can be pinned to it, no words
image.notes: Nothing pinned. The board is full.

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving
